rule: Local reviewer tool list, read from its '  - <name>' lines, is exactly its seven named tools, and its frontmatter contains no claude-mem
description: plugin/agents/local-reviewer.md is the local review agent. Its frontmatter tools: list is what grants it tools, and the local reviewer reads no claude-mem memory. The set_check captures every line of the form '  - <name>' (two spaces, a dash, a space, then the name up to the first whitespace) and requires, in equal mode with expected_counts, exactly these members, each once: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, Grep and Skill, plus question:, which is the one body line of that form (the user_answer question field in the Input Contract block), pinned so the extraction stays honest. An added tool fails as an extra, whatever its spelling, so a wildcard grant such as mcp__*, an underscore spelling, or any other memory tool fails; a duplicated tool fails its count, and a deleted tool fails as missing. set_check is used because an added grant is the threat, and a presence pin can only notice deletion. The frontmatter-absent consumer requires that the substring claude-mem appears nowhere in the frontmatter, so a claude-mem grant written outside the '  - <name>' form also fails. What this fixture does not check: (a) what each listed tool can do; the pin claims names, never capability or meaning; (b) a tool written outside the '  - <name>' form, such as an inline list, a different indent or a second tools key, unless its text contains claude-mem; no frontmatter parser backs this fixture, because tools/policy_check.sh keeps its frontmatter checks line-scoped; (c) body prose beyond the '  - <name>' lines: absent is scoped to frontmatter; the extract regex is line-scoped and not limited to the frontmatter, so a new body line of that form fails equal mode as an extra; (d) grants from any other source, such as settings files, hooks, or the prompt that starts the local reviewer; (e) any other agent file; files is a literal list that names only local-reviewer.md and is blind to newly added files.
